purpose: 以另行保存的检查点复核较早的允许决策，显示完整结果及历史策略版本。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive ledger.audit --org 'acme factory' --seq 2 --end-seq 8 --fingerprint "$(cat ledger.fingerprint)"
output:
target sequence: 2
original decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["p-ledger-read-2026", "p-ledger-scope-2026"]
  policy version: 1
recomputed decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["p-ledger-read-2026", "p-ledger-scope-2026"]
  policy version: 1
consistent: yes

purpose: 同一材料仅将末条记录的缺省变更载荷标记改为255并重算外层校验，观察整份拒绝且不输出较早决策。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive ledger-marker.audit --org 'acme factory' --seq 2 --end-seq 8 --fingerprint "$(cat ledger.fingerprint)"
output:
review: archive validation failed: darksafe: invalid audit archive: invalid change payload marker
exit status 1
